verdict.rationale: Decagon documents mechanisms that constrain agent behavior — Agent Operating Procedures let teams define behavior in natural language 'the same way you train human agents with SOPs' (decagon-docs-16), and Duet-generated tests verify agents 'respond accurately, follow policies' (decagon-docs-11), plus Watchtower flags policy violations (decagon-docs-8/20). However, there is no explicit evidence describing a 'safe decline' behavior for off-knowledge questions or anti-hallucination grounding controls that stop invented prices/promises specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of decline/refusal behavior on out-of-scope queries, evidence of hallucination-prevention/grounding mechanisms, and independent verification that guardrails actually prevent invented policy/price claims in practice.
